meaning.en: A person who is prominent in fashionable society.

meaning.en: A person (more often a woman) of social prominence, considered to be an influential figure.
meaning.vi: Một người (thường là phụ nữ) nổi tiếng trong xã hội, được coi là một nhân vật có ảnh hưởng.

meaning.en: A person who goes to fashionable parties and is often written about in the newspapers, etc.
meaning.vi: Một người hay đi dự các bữa tiệc thời trang và thường được viết trên báo, v.v.

sentences.en: For example, Madonna's "Material Girl" is accompanied by the story of a couple of socialites (not unlike Nicole Richie and Paris Hilton) who are stranded on a desert island.

sentences.en: As one of Hollywood's most noted socialites, Nicole Richie has had her fair share of troubles with alcohol and drug use.

sentences.en: You shouldn't be tanning anyway, which is why Alice + Olivia crafted this particular design to meet the needs of sun-damage concerned socialites.
